purpose: Isolate and test the nine-candidate probability mechanism: factorial transition prior, likelihood update, parameter and process-noise marginals, frozen extreme-likelihood stability and causal prefix invariance.
repairs_from_v01: Count all 50 dynamic floating-point values, one integer and one Boolean saved per trial-day, plus every static and per-trial array, in the task-specific memory estimate.
Freeze the extreme log-likelihood input, production output, independent reconstruction and explicit pass gates in checksummed evidence.
Put every gated numerical value in gate_values and freeze switch-day and non-switch-day stratified accuracy diagnostics.

parameter_source.source_basin_description: the first frozen formal basin; a small snow-influenced storage-and-infiltration basin used only to freeze the existing three complete parameter labels

emission_mean_interpretation: dimensionless ordered synthetic diagnostics assigned to the three frozen labels; they have no hydrologic state or parameter-value interpretation
emission_rule: two conditionally independent Gaussian diagnostics, one for the true parameter label and one for the true process-noise label
truth_mode_rule: uniform initial joint candidate followed by the frozen three-by-three factorial transition matrix
extreme_likelihood_check_rule: Apply the production probability update once to the frozen vector with a uniform prior, independently reconstruct the normalized probabilities, and save both outputs and the pass certificate.
scope_limit: This is a probability-algebra validation with synthetic Gaussian label diagnostics. It tests stable-stage probability tracking and records weak switch-day performance; it does not test whether hydrologic filter likelihoods are calibrated, whether states should interact or whether forecasts improve.
